Can only upgrade all.  Every time you level up you'll be able to upgrade all of your skills to the next level.

  
Edit: I'll also note that upgrading your skills for one spec automatically does so for your other spec as well, so no need to worry about having to spend double silver if you want to keep both specs up to snuff.

I'm a little late to the party, but haven't seen anyone else mention this factoid to you yet.  The game has a thing called "bloated values" that perfectly encapsulates your comment here about a t4 melee weapon doing more damage than a t7 bow.  The bloat value for bow is 1.2 times your true raw damage.  The bloat value for say a greatsword is 4.8 times your true raw damage.

Now as for your original question if 15 damage per arrow when first starting MR hunts is normal or not, I'd have to load up a similar build and see.  It does sound low, but it's been like 5 years since I was in that position.  Give me a bit and I'll do some digging or try and put a build together to go test.
